Needs changes before merge: one Frame cost rule violation.

The trial merge with upstream/main is clean. The preview tests pass. The body has before/after screenshots on the fork's images branch. I read the full diff and checked all six screenshots.

## Requested before merge

1. **Cache the Properties cutter outline.** [crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs:57](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/8a7519e5977687229711c7e42a251c018feb4c4b/crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs#L57): With a landed cutter, Properties now calls `cutter_profile::check(...).map(|s| s.outline())` on every frame, on every tab. The check also builds an outline in `cutter_profile::agrees`. The caller, `tool_settings::contents`, runs each frame. Thus unchanged inputs cause repeated validation and arc flattening. The library's model memo does not cover this path. This breaks the current `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` Frame cost rule. Cache the validation result and outline by the tool values and cutter draft inputs. Add counter tests for unchanged and changed inputs in Properties. The new `a_still_frame_computes_no_mesh` test measures only the library model and projection counters.

Reply to the review of 8a7519e59 (finding 1: "Cache the Properties cutter outline").

## The fix

- Commit 4ed09c9f7 closes finding 1. Commit 3505c51d5 adds the two tests before the fix.
- The Properties preview now keeps the cutter check and its outline in a memo. The key is the draft tool value and the cutter draft points. The key does not use `doc_version`. This is the same pattern as the model memo of the library preview.
- A still frame reads the memo. A changed tool value or a changed point computes the check and the outline one time.
- The work has the name `ui/properties.tool.cutter_outline` (`frame_cost::span`).
- `preview_inputs` and the memo are now in a new module, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_preview_inputs.rs` (95 lines). `tool_profile_page.rs` goes from 415 lines to 370 lines.

## The new tests (ui lib, `egui_app::tests::tool_library_preview`)

- `properties_still_frame_computes_no_cutter_outline`: with a landed cutter, three still Properties frames compute no check and no outline.
- `properties_changed_tool_computes_the_cutter_outline_once`: a changed draft diameter computes the outline one time, and the landed outline no longer shows.
- On 3505c51d5 (no memo), the two tests fail: 3 computes in 3 frames.

## Gate (Windows, final head 4ed09c9f7)

- The head merges cleanly with origin/main 582981bfa. No merge commit was necessary.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 18 steps, 18 ok, 0 failed, 0 stalled. `ui suites: lib`: 1606 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The PR keeps its ready flag (#3727). The new head is 4ed09c9f7. It waits for a fresh review.

Ready for a re-check.

## Earlier findings

1. **Fixed: cache the Properties cutter outline.** Commit `4ed09c9f7` adds the memo in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_preview_inputs.rs`. Its key uses the draft tool value and cutter points. It caches valid outlines and failed checks. It does not use `doc_version`. The work has a `frame_cost::span` name. Both new counter tests pass locally:
   - `properties_still_frame_computes_no_cutter_outline`: no compute during three still frames.
   - `properties_changed_tool_computes_the_cutter_outline_once`: one compute after the diameter changes; the old outline does not show.
